title: What's your role in your friend group? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free friend group role quiz: are you the planner, the caretaker, the comedian, the adventurer, the mediator or the wildcard? Answer 12 quick questions. No sign-up.
h1: What's your role in your friend group?
lede: Every group of friends has its planner, its caretaker and its comedian. Answer 12 questions about trips, group chats and birthdays to find out which of six roles you play.
about: Friend groups tend to share out roles without anyone deciding it: someone books the restaurant, someone checks everyone got home, someone keeps the group chat funny. Knowing your role can explain why you feel tired after organizing every trip, or why everyone calls you when there's drama.

This quiz was written for cv.cm, just for fun. Each of the six roles appears equally often in the answers, so every result is equally possible. Your result shows your main role and how strongly you lean toward each of the others.

faq.a: The planner (organizes everything), the caretaker (looks after everyone), the comedian (keeps everyone laughing), the adventurer (always up for something new), the mediator (keeps the peace) and the wildcard (nobody knows what you'll do next).
Yes. You might be the planner with school friends and the comedian with family. Answer with one group in mind, then take it again for another.
No. It is a light-hearted quiz, not a scientific measure of personality.
No. The quiz is scored in your browser and nothing is uploaded.

items.q: A friend suggests a last-minute weekend trip. You…
options: Say yes before they finish the sentence
Start thinking of funny things to film on the way
Check that everyone's okay with the plan first
Suggest a completely different, weirder destination

items.q: In the group chat, you're the one who…
options: Sends a random voice note at 3 a.m.
Asks if everyone got home safe
Posts a poll with three possible dates
Calms things down when an argument starts
Doing impressions in the middle of the room
Talking someone into a game nobody has heard of
Making sure there's enough food and water
Daring people to go somewhere else afterward

items.q: A friend's birthday is coming up. You…
options: Booked the restaurant a month ago
Get everyone to agree on one gift from the whole group
Bake their favorite cake
Prepare an embarrassing speech

items.q: The group is bored on a rainy afternoon. You…
options: Start a ridiculous story everyone has to continue
Already have a list of indoor plans
Suggest going out anyway and getting soaked
Turn up with a strange board game from a flea market

items.q: Two friends aren't speaking to each other. You…
options: Drag them both out for something exciting
Check that each of them is okay
Do something so unexpected they both laugh
Talk to each side and help them meet halfway

items.q: Your friends would trust you with…
options: The tickets, passports and timetable
A sad moment they need to laugh through
A secret plan nobody else would approve
Their plants and their cat while they're away

items.q: On a group holiday, your favorite moment is…
options: The night nobody planned and nobody can explain
Trying the scariest ride or the highest cliff jump
Everyone finally agreeing where to eat
Seeing the itinerary run perfectly

items.q: When a friend is sick, you…
options: Bring soup, medicine and a blanket
Make a schedule of who visits when
Send them memes until they feel better
Promise them a big adventure when they recover
Making sure nobody is left out of the frame
Doing something strange in the background
Pulling the funniest face
Fixing someone's collar

items.q: The group can't decide on a film. You…
options: Find the one everyone can live with
Suggest skipping the film and going on a night walk
Already made a shortlist with ratings
Act out the trailers until someone chooses
The one who looks after us
The peacemaker
The one who's always up for anything
The one who keeps us organized

planner.name: The planner
planner.body: Without you, the trip would never happen. You book, you remind, you make the spreadsheet, and everyone secretly relies on it. Let someone else plan now and then: you deserve to just turn up.

caretaker.name: The caretaker
caretaker.body: You notice who's quiet, who hasn't eaten and who needs a ride home. Friends come to you when life is hard. Remember to let them look after you too.

comedian.name: The comedian
comedian.body: You keep the group laughing, even on bad days, and your jokes end up as the group's inside jokes. It's okay to be serious sometimes: your friends want to hear that side of you too.

adventurer.name: The adventurer
adventurer.body: You're the first to say yes, and the reason the group has its best stories. You pull people out of their comfort zone. Just check now and then that everyone is having fun, not only you.

mediator.name: The mediator
mediator.body: You keep the peace. You hear both sides, find the middle ground and make sure nobody is left out. Don't forget that your own opinion counts too.

wildcard.name: The wildcard
wildcard.body: Nobody knows what you'll do next, and that's why life is never boring with you around. Your odd ideas become the group's legends. Give your friends a little warning before the next one.
